summary: Alset Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing it terminated a February 5, 2026 agreement to sell 505,341,376 shares (99.55%) of Hapi Metaverse Inc. to HWH International Inc. for $19,910,603 via a convertible promissory note at $1.85/share, with 1% simple interest and a 5-year maturity. Management mutually determined termination was in both parties' best interests; no penalties or fees were paid. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium details are mentioned. The filing reports only the termination of the prior accord. The key watchpoint is whether any alternative transaction for Hapi Metaverse emerges.
